    About this item

    • 【Casual Style】Classic nude black/grey color enable these flats shoes to be WORKING GAL GO TO SHOES. Just slip them on and go!
    • 【Buttery Soft】We use skin-friendly suede upper to make these ballet flats, plus enough padding on the bottom, giving you buttery soft wearing experience. Bringing cute and comfortable flats to our customers is HEAWISH’s constant pursuit!
    • 【Goes With Any Decoration】Basic style goes with every day casual and office wear. You can pair these dress shoes with many kinds of outfits, like jeans, dresses, shirts, etc.
    • 【Non-slip Rubber Sole】Anti-slip rubber sole protects your feet from slippery grounds. These lightweight flats shoes not only have sturdy structure, but also can be folded into bags which is convenient for those who are travel enthusiast or away on business.
    • 【HEAWISH Customer Service】Contact us if you have any question about these ballet flats before or after purchasing, we will reply your mails within 1-24 hrs and help you to solve the problem in earnest. Thank you for your support!

    Product description

    WHY choose HEAWISH comfortable ballet flats?

    1. We have professional experience of making high quality comfortable shoes, especially flats. We are a store that just opened in September 2019 but we have many regular customers now.
    2. These pointed toe flats leave enough room at the top so that they won't squeeze your toes.This shoe style runs small, so we recommend ordering half a size or one size up.
    3. We are making progress constantly and will listen to every customer's voice, suggestions are welcome. :)

    DETAILS

    Here are details what we considered for you:

    Elegant Pointy Toe: These black/grey flats shoes are pointed toe but leave enough room for your toes that won't squeeze them.

    Buttery Soft: We use premium material to make these ballet women's flats, not only do they give you buttery soft wearing experience, but they are also graceful due to their premium quality.

    Can Be Folded: If you are a travel enthusiast, then these dress shoes are you indispensable companion, they can be easily packaged and accompany you to anywhere.

    WEARING SHOW OF LEOPARD FLATS

    Choosing size please refer below (insole length, insole width):

    US6: 10.07'', 3.14''

    US7: 10.34'', 3.32''

    US8: 10.60'', 3.50''

    US9: 10.86'', 3.68''

    US10:11.12'', 3.85''

    US11: 11.39'', 4.03''

    OCCASIONS

    Casual style and nude colors make these flats shoes suitable for working, driving, parties, travelling, casual daily wear, etc.

    5 out of 5 stars
    a good shoe but...
    I normally wear a 7.5/8 women's shoe. With flats I usually order the smaller size as I don't want the back side flipping off while I walk, and one foot is slightly larger than the other. However, I reordered these in an 8 as the 7.5 were really tight. When first wearing the size 8, they were still tight, leaving red lined indents across the top of my feet. The more I wore them though, the more they stretched out and the more comfortable they became. After a year of wearing them (a lot), the inside lining is starting to pull away, which is really annoying to feel as you are walking around during the day. There is also a good amount of room in the toe area, which I didn't expect with pointed toe shoes. My feet do get sweaty after wearing them and being on my feet all day, which is probably why the lining is coming detached - there isn't a way for the foot moisture to escape (I do wear them barefoot, not with socks/hose). Given their price, I would order them again, although I don't really want to go through the hassle of "breaking them in" again.

      4.0 out of 5 stars Great shoe Bad sizing. Pointy Toe!
      Reviewed in the United States on September 29, 2025
      Size: 9Color: NavyVerified Purchase
      I wanted to love these. I have their floral cut fabric shoes- so I’m a fan of this brand.
      I read all the reviews, so I purchased these in my size and one full size up.
      I was pleasantly surprised at the quality of the shoe! If this isn’t suede, then they had me fooled!
      I was not surprised that my size did not fit but the size up did. I wanted SO to love them! They are comfortable!
      But-
      My problem was that on one foot it was tighter in width than the other. Too tight. They didn’t seem to relax in the half hour or so I walked on my carpeting so I decided, reluctantly to return them and because of the pointed toe.
      They advertise the shoe to seem that they aren’t a pointed toed shoe, but they are. If you like that, then you are going to love these if not…
      By the way, the blue is a pretty darker dusty blue color and the green is a beautiful, darker rich green.
